$comment: Placeable props. `sprite` names a PNG exported with `HK_TK2D_Exporter --export-sprites` into skins/Vanilla/props (game art, git-ignored). `seat` is the seat height as a fraction of the sprite height (from the bottom). `sit_offset` nudges the knight's sitting pose in game units.

discoveries.$comment: Art for things found in windows (crates/skong/src/discoveries.rs), exported like the benches. Geo deposit: a rock (geo is drawn on). Trapped grub: the jar (`brk_bottle`; the grub inside is the `Grub2` clip library) and two glass shards that fly when it breaks.

shinies.$comment: Glints on the ground for the knight to pick up (crates/skong/src/shinies.rs, skong_core::shiny). Drawn procedurally, no art. One turns up every `every_secs` [min, max] of time the user is around and not typing hard; at most `max` at once; gone after `lifetime_secs`; picking one up pops out `geo` [min, max] Geo with chance `geo_chance`; never closer than `min_distance` px (at scale 1) to the knight.
